title: Graphiti bi-temporal memory
abstract: Graphiti proposes an Episode, Entity, EntityEdge bi-temporal memory model for agent harnesses with provable temporal queries.

title: Cognee DataPoint tree
abstract: Cognee introduces the DataPoint tree with Pydantic schemas and dependency injection for structured memory pipelines.

title: Mem0 fact centric memory
abstract: Mem0 argues for a fact-centric memory API with simple put, get, and search operations.

title: GraphRAG community summarization
abstract: GraphRAG leverages community detection on extracted knowledge graphs to power long-context summarization.

title: ACT-R base level learning
abstract: Anderson 1996 ACT-R base-level learning describes memory activation as a function of recency and frequency.

title: Petrov ACT-R approximation
abstract: Petrov 2006 proposes an O(1) incremental approximation for ACT-R base-level activation computation.

title: SQL 2011 PERIOD
abstract: SQL 2011 PERIOD specification formalizes bi-temporal valid-time and system-time columns in relational databases.

title: HNSW graph index
abstract: Hierarchical Navigable Small World graphs provide a state of the art approximate nearest neighbor index for high-dimensional vectors.

title: BM25 ranking function
abstract: BM25 is the canonical probabilistic ranking function for keyword-based information retrieval over inverted indices.

title: Reciprocal rank fusion
abstract: Reciprocal rank fusion combines multiple ranked lists with a simple k-plus-rank reciprocal weighting scheme.

title: pgvector extension
abstract: pgvector brings vector similarity search to Postgres with HNSW and IVFFlat index types.

title: Apache AGE graph
abstract: Apache AGE adds a property graph and Cypher query dialect to Postgres.

title: pgmq durable queue
abstract: pgmq provides a durable at-least-once message queue on top of Postgres with per-queue visibility timeouts.

title: Turbo quantization
abstract: Turbo quantization compresses float32 vectors to 4 or 8 bits while preserving recall quality for HNSW.

title: EmbeddingGemma 768
abstract: EmbeddingGemma 768 is a 768-dimensional sentence encoder tuned for retrieval augmented generation.

title: BGE reranker v2 m3
abstract: BGE reranker v2 m3 is a cross-encoder that reorders top-k retrieval candidates for downstream generation.

title: Label propagation Leiden
abstract: Label propagation Leiden is a fast community detection algorithm suitable for incremental graph updates.

title: Helios Rust agent harness
abstract: Helios is a Claude-Code-class Rust agent harness with Read, Write, Edit, Grep tools over a bi-temporal scratchpad.

title: Moon Redis substrate
abstract: Moon is a Redis-compatible substrate exposing FT.CREATE, GRAPH.QUERY, TEMPORAL.SNAPSHOT_AT, and MQ.PUSH in one process.

title: Lunaris memory engine
abstract: Lunaris is a production-grade agent memory engine with sub-25 millisecond recall over millions of bi-temporal facts.
